question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**throughout**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Throughout **means in every part of something **(सारा-का-सारा, किसी वस्‍तु के प्रत्‍येक भाग में**). 

 
 
• **​Example: ***People **throughout **the country are out of work.*
 
 
 
• All the other options are contextually incorrect.

 

​​​​​​Hence, option 3 is the correct answer. 

Complete Sentence__: *Picking an assortment within every food group __**throughout**__ the week will help you.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

__
 
• **Complete **means having all the necessary or appropriate parts (**सभी आवश्यक या उपयुक्त भाग होना**).

 
 
• **Example: *Complete**** the sentence with one of the adjectives provided.*
 
 
 
• **Between: Between__**__ is often used to refer to the **time, space**, or **differences **that separate two things, people, places, ideas, etc__.
 __
 
• **Example:* ****The town lies halfway **between **Rome and Florence.*
 
 
 
• **Every****:** We use **"**____**every" **to refer to a group or list of** ****three or more things****.** We use a singular verb and a singular noun with "each__".
 
 
• **​Example: ***The police want to interview **every **employee about the theft.*
